name: Dr. Julia Ju
headline: Global Head Commercial Excellence @ Sulzer Chemtech | Expert in B2B Growth | ex-Bain
summary:
I create steady and predictable stream of qualified leads for B2B companies with complex products and long sales cycles based on a solid strategy foundation. 

I bring in passion to unlock potential at customer, company, team and personal level. Cross-functional and regional leadership expertise in B2B with a focus on Strategy, Marketing and Digitization.

Currently heading a cross functional team of 40+ team members and overseeing Digital OI / Sales as CMO / CSO at Körber Pharma, a leading supplier for the Pharmaceutical industry. Körber Pharma offers integrated solutions going beyond products unlocking the potential of your business.

Overall 10 years experience in corporate strategy, business development, marketing and sales. Core strengths include strategy / business development, market due diligence, project management, digital marketing and sales. Proven ability leading cross-functional / multi-national teams and delivering strong financial and operational results. Experienced in a broad set of industries with primary focus on Industrial Goods.

company.name: Sulzer
company.description: Sulzer is a global leader in critical applications for core infrastructure and processes for large essential industries around the world. We ensure the security, quality and durability of critical goods and services by supporting energy security, natural resource management and efficiencies in process industries. This in turn supports the transition to a circular economy. Our integrated solutions add significant value by enabling energy efficiency, carbon emissions and pollution reduction, and process efficiency improvements. Customers benefit from our commitment to innovation, performance and quality through our responsive network of 160 world-class manufacturing facilities and service centers across the globe. Sulzer has been headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, since 1834. In 2025, our 13’500 employees delivered revenues of CHF 3.6 billion. Our shares are traded on the SIX Swiss Exchange (SIX: SUN).
